name: primitives-texts-rolling
title: Rolling Text
description: Two lines of text that arrive as individual characters flipping around a horizontal axis, sweeping left to right, the subtitle starting after a short pause.
use: A hero headline should arrive with a rewarding reveal once it scrolls into view.
avoid: Body copy or long paragraphs: per-character delays slow reading and the motion distracts.
a11y: The visible characters are hidden from assistive tech and the full text is exposed, but there is no reduced-motion fallback. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A large bold white headline and a smaller grey subtitle, both centred on a near-black stage. During the effect a character is briefly edge-on or missing, leaving a gap in the line until it drops back into place.
behaves: On entering the viewport each character rotates ninety degrees up into its slot, staggered along the sentence; the second line waits a little longer. Everything settles into still, normally spaced text.
customise: Text, an extra delay and the transition timing come in as props; changing the flip axis or the per-character stagger needs a source edit.
weight: light: A few spans per character driven by two transforms each, with no running loop.
